newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends near flat, commercial selling noted.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends near flat, commercial selling noted.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed nearly flat with early gains trimmed by small lot commercial selling, tied to hedge sales of producer stocks, traders said.
"There was commercial selling near the end of the day which was hedging," a trader said.
Traders also said that attempts to rally the market were stymied by steady to easier values overseas.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 300 contracts, below the 351 traded Thursday, according to the CBOT.
Rice closed unchanged to 1/2 cent lower, with January unchanged at $10.45 per cwt.
